language.title: Interface language
language.description: Applies to app menus and controls only. Notes and exports stay unchanged.
mode.title: Color mode
mode.description: Follow the system to switch between the light and dark colors of your theme.
theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Each theme includes light and dark colors.
background.title: Background
background.description: Add a soft gradient behind the window using the current theme.
background.motionDescription: Colors drift slowly. Animation stops when the system requests reduced motion.
font.title: Fonts
font.description: Apply to the interface and editor content.
font.codeDescription: Monospaced text in code blocks and the interface.
font.sizeDescription: Editor text follows the selected size; interface text scales at half the rate.
pageMargin.title: Page margins
pageMargin.description: Adjust horizontal margins for reading and editing. Content adapts automatically to the window width.
highlight.title: Highlighting
highlight.description: Highlight style for all documents and published blogs.
image.title: Content images
image.description: Default appearance for images and galleries without their own settings.
